purpose: Allow an independently created autonomous agent to connect itself to ProgreTech Mesh without requiring the owner to log into the agent workstation.
agent_steps: Validate that the owner intentionally requested Mesh enrollment.
Read the PTM1 enrollment envelope and this protocol document.
Inspect your own runtime and available installation capabilities.
Select a compatible Mesh adapter from the adapter catalog.
Download only the package/version declared by Mesh.
Verify package integrity and any supported signature/identity metadata.
Install or stage the adapter using your existing local authority only.
If activation requires a runtime restart, wait until current work is idle.
Connect outbound to Mesh and prove passive monitoring is active.
Keep Mesh conversation state separate from existing chat channels.
Report success or the minimum missing capability to the owner.

failure_policy.on_insufficient_permissions: Do not bypass policy. Tell the owner exactly what approval or capability is missing.
failure_policy.on_unknown_runtime: Do not guess. Request the generic adapter path only if your environment can run it safely.
failure_policy.on_active_work: Defer activation/restart until the current work is idle.
